Name: Forest Farm with More Room
Author: hazel214
Description:
To install: download, unzip, place the xnb file into stardew valley/content/maps and let it replace the existing file. Make sure to save a copy of the farm_foraging file first in case you want the old one back. 

This removes the big middle lake, the big middle patch of grass, and the lake/grass circle in the lower right corner. 

I am not a pro modder at all so this might have hiccups, but it works fine in my game!

Also because this is just the xnb file, it wont work with any other mods that alter the look of the foraging farm.

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
